entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We all agreed to do it,[n]but we still haven't[n]resolved it, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I get so restless just having[n]to sit around and wait.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wanna go take care of it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh yeah, we still haven't finished[n]Mishima's request.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we're going to Mementos, do you[n]want to have everyone gather at the[n]hideout?
entries.uk: Якщо йдемо в Мементос, може,[n]збереш усіх у схованці?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: OK! I'll count on you[n]to gather everyone.
